preRegistrationValues.nonDiagnosticPurpose: Deliver the missing task-facing Codex reference projection so a person can state a goal without first learning the Harness profile, Codex plugin composition, Skill invocation, MCP, Hook, CC Switch, configuration, or task-topology mechanics. The usable source package is the primary deliverable; it is not created merely to exercise or diagnose the Harness.

demandEntry.demand: Assume the user knows nothing about Codex and make the Agent recognize intent and help from zero at every point instead of teaching the user which capability, product, command, configuration, or workflow to operate.
demandEntry.observedRepositoryProblem: At commit 784c26dd813a8a38764c896bbcda1d2ec7385001, the Codex plugin tree 5af87a619fbd8a020f2751eafa3cc4a8dedf002d packages only a repository-local continuation Hook and launcher. It exposes no task-facing Skill, so the candidate can project Harness authority inside this repository but cannot carry the demand-to-capability method into an ordinary goal-level Codex task.
demandEntry.settledProductFormBoundary: The existing Codex reference projection remains plugin-compatible and manager-agnostic. Skills are the default task-facing payload, MCP is admitted only for a later reproducible runtime or data gap, and Hooks remain an optional host continuity edge rather than the portable product core.

goalAndBoundedAuthority.goal: Add one concise, version-bound, task-facing Skill to the existing Codex plugin source candidate so Codex can apply the candidate demand-to-capability method from a goal without requiring the user to name the Skill or operate capability, context, or task-topology mechanics.
goalAndBoundedAuthority.agentAuthority: Read and edit the current repository on main; use the already-installed official plugin-creator and skill-creator guidance, official public Codex plugin documentation, native Codex, Git, PowerShell, and Python; validate, remove exact task-owned residue, commit, and push main.
goalAndBoundedAuthority.humanRetains: Accountable acceptance of the delivered source package and bounded claim, plus any install, enable, trust, consumer mutation, live behavior trial, new account or data boundary, cost, publication, release, deployment, destructive action, or irreversible effect.
goalAndBoundedAuthority.excludedOperations: No plugin installation or enablement, Hook activation, user or personal marketplace mutation, config.toml mutation, CC Switch dependency, MCP server, App, account connection, external model dispatch, publication, release, deployment, branch, worktree, repository fork, conversation fork, or new task.
